minutes.headline: Stormwater Task Force approved its September minutes and took an action to research how a stormwater utility would be governed.
minutes.summary: The task force heard an update on EPA's CREAT climate-resilience tool and possible EPA funding calls. It discussed how a stormwater utility would be funded, governed and how its fees would be controlled. The September 19, 2024 minutes were approved, a member took an action to research the Town Charter and enterprise-fund governance, and December's meeting was skipped in favor of January.

budget_items.topic: Capital plan and Chapter 90 for stormwater projects
budget_items.what_was_said: Members discussed capital requests for stormwater design and construction and how much Chapter 90 money could go to stormwater. The Chapter 90 amount was said to come every year but is not guaranteed.

budget_items.topic: Possible EPA funding sources for stormwater
budget_items.what_was_said: Some Massachusetts towns plan a call with EPA about funding sources. The meeting is not yet scheduled.

budget_items.topic: Yearly fees and cost structure for businesses
budget_items.what_was_said: A member will reach out about coming up with yearly fees and a cost structure for businesses, and wants to know how many businesses there are and their tiers.
